officialSendingAgency.name: Manpower Training and Overseas Sending Board (MTOSB)

informationOffice.address: Phum Prey Popel, SK. Somrong Krom, Khan Po Sen Chey, Phnom Penh

testCenters.note: HRD Korea lists Cambodia test-center entries at National Polytechnic Institute of Cambodia; use the current cycle notice before travel.

evidenceNotes: HRD Korea identifies MTOSB as Cambodia's EPS sending agency.
HRD Korea lists the Cambodia information office in Khan Po Sen Chey, Phnom Penh.
Official HRD Korea candidates-for-skills list contains Cambodia the 2th Test of proficiency in Korean Announcement (General CBT), published 2026-08-06.
Official HRD Korea pass list contains Cambodia the 2th POINT_EXAM Announcement (General CBT), published 2026-08-21.
The public titles do not themselves state Manufacturing, so KEP does not auto-link those official artifacts to the Manufacturing route without direct cycle/sector proof.
A non-official discovery mirror points to a 12th Cambodia Manufacturing Point System with registration 2026-05-22 through 2026-05-25; those dates are discovery-only and not promoted as exact.
The official 11th Cambodia Agriculture and Livestock schedule is separate-sector evidence and must never populate Manufacturing rules.
A separate Cambodia Special CBT result was published 2026-09-09 and must remain outside Regular Manufacturing.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Use only a current Cambodia Manufacturing notice for complete cycle-specific eligibility. Generic EPS eligibility and Agriculture-sector rules are not current Manufacturing exact rules.

stages.title: Manufacturing registration
stages.action: KEP has not promoted the 2026 Manufacturing registration window because the direct official Manufacturing schedule artifact has not yet been captured. A non-official discovery source suggests a 12th Manufacturing cycle, but its dates remain discovery-only.

stages.title: Application / test fee
stages.action: No Cambodia Manufacturing cycle-specific fee is promoted until a current official Manufacturing notice is captured.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Follow only current Cambodia official identity and anti-fraud requirements. Do not import another country's biometric steps.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: The current Manufacturing passport/photo/upload/payment checklist is not promoted until a direct official Manufacturing notice is reviewed.

stages.title: Manufacturing test-date notice
stages.action: The exact official Manufacturing test schedule is not promoted in KEP until the direct schedule detail is captured. Do not reuse Agriculture or Special dates.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — Manufacturing
stages.action: HRD Korea has an official Cambodia General CBT skills-candidate announcement dated 2026-08-06, but the public title does not itself state Manufacturing. KEP therefore preserves the artifact while keeping exact Manufacturing cycle linkage gated.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.action: HRD Korea published Cambodia the 2th Test of proficiency in Korean Announcement (General CBT) on 2026-08-06 as candidates for skills test. KEP will not assert exact Manufacturing linkage until the cycle/sector artifact is verified.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: HRD Korea published Cambodia the 2th POINT_EXAM Announcement (General CBT) on 2026-08-21. KEP preserves this official result artifact but does not auto-link it to the Manufacturing route without direct cycle/sector proof.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Cambodia psychology stage is asserted from the verified Manufacturing evidence.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Use only current Cambodia Manufacturing medical/provider instructions. Exact provider, checklist and fee remain HOLD.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: After a verified current Manufacturing final result, follow current Cambodia candidate-file instructions. Exact documents and timing remain HOLD.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.action: Only officially qualified candidates proceed to employer selection. Private intermediaries cannot guarantee roster priority or placement.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for selection through the official EPS system. No private intermediary can guarantee a specific Korean employer.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected, follow current official Cambodia/EPS instructions for SLC review/signing and next steps.

stages.title: Post-SLC Cambodia requirements
stages.action: Follow current official instructions for medical follow-up, training, visa documents, payments and departure preparation.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use the current Cambodia/Korean-mission visa checklist and fees. Exact current Manufacturing downstream details are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete only the official pre-departure training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow current Cambodia instructions only if a final health recheck is explicitly required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only after official contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
